## Functions

### Disclosure()

```ts
function Disclosure(__namedParameters): Element;
```

A controlled one-line disclosure over Base UI Collapsible. The header is a
native button carrying `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`, so Enter and Space
toggle it.
